The stock has “Neutral” rating by Nomura on Friday, September 28. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) earned “Buy” rating by Wedbush on Tuesday, November 27.
The stock decreased 9.31% or $14.7 during the last trading session, reaching $143.22. About 71.11M shares traded or 69.81% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 0.17% uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.17% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on February, 7. They expect $4.74 earnings per share, up 21.85 % or $0.85 from last year’s $3.89 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $22.49B for 7.55 P/E if the $4.74 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.91 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 62.89 % EPS growth.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $679.65 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 12.03 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
